name: Selfish Parrot 52
author: Mhyar-nsi
description: Neon sky-blue text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, border becomes 1px solid #3b82f6, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 4px #3b83f65f.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Selfish Parrot 52</title>
<style>
/* Selfish Parrot 52 by Mhyar-nsi — https://uiverse.io/Mhyar-nsi/selfish-parrot-52 */
.input {
  font-family: monospace;
  max-width: 190px;
  outline: none;
  border: 1px solid #dadada;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background-color: #f3f7fe;
  transition: .3s;
  color: #3b82f6;
}

.input:focus {
  border: 1px solid #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #3b83f65f
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Type here..." class="input" name="text" type="text">

</body>
</html>
